integrity.finite_verification: standalone exact-rational checks in verify.py; not a proof of infinite claims
integrity.provenance: The delayed-map model and geometric plateaus are credited to the cited literature; the exact Cesàro interval is the claim assessed here.

scientific_limitations: The accumulation interval requires dense original tent-map orbit; it is not asserted for all initial points.
Only the exact dyadic homogeneous delay and full-slope tent map are treated.
No extension to noisy, inhomogeneous, or arbitrary-proportional-delay dynamics is proved.
Originality comparison is evidence against coverage by inspected sources, not proof of historical priority.
title: A sharp Cesàro interval for dyadically held tent-map orbits
